verdict.rationale: Gecko posts pass/fail checks back to GitHub/GitLab PRs (gecko-security-docs-5) and integrates via GitHub App/API to trigger scans (gecko-security-docs-1, gecko-security-docs-10), implying CI gating is possible, but there is no explicit documentation of a CLI/CI exit-code mechanism, no example CI pipeline config (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI YAML), and community reports raise accuracy concerns (false positives/negatives) that could undermine trust in build-blocking use. missing for 10: explicit CI exit-code/CLI documentation, sample pipeline configs, and independent verification that the pass/fail check reliably blocks merges without high false-positive noise.
